title: Field: Manual Pilot Mode Confirmed — RS-21 and RS-22

lines.text: Supervisor Oyelowo to Gas Control. Tech Harris at RS-21 switched the worker to the mechanical pilot at 17:36; same at RS-22 at 17:38. Station outlets are falling back toward 10 in. w.c., but PR-7B still reads 24 in. w.c.: the district is still above its 14 in. w.c. MAOP and will take time to bleed down.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This is a key confirmation inject. The FOS must now initiate the paper trip sheet process and hold all actions pending authorization. Watch for any attempt to bypass manual procedures.

voiceLines.speaker: Field Supervisor Oyelowo
voiceLines.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath
voiceLines.text: This is Supervisor Oyelowo. I’ve just confirmed with Tech Harris at RS-21: the pilot regulator is manually switched to mechanical mode and holding pressure at thirteen point two inches water column on the field gauge. Same for RS-22. The setpoint is not changing on SCADA, but the field is stable and real. We have two independent confirmations. No more guesswork—this is overpressure. I’m sending a paper trip sheet to Gas Control for manual isolation authorization.
